Setext Heading One
==================

Prose under a setext heading, which is the older syntax and still
appears in vaults that were migrated from other tools.

Setext Heading Two
------------------

> [!NOTE]
> A callout. Obsidian writes these as a blockquote with a marker on the
> first line, so anything that handles blockquotes handles them.

> [!WARNING]
> A second callout, immediately after, separated by a blank line.

## Lists

1. An ordered item
2. Another ordered item
   - A nested unordered item
   - Another nested item
     - Deeper still
3. Back to the top level

- [ ] An unchecked task
- [x] A checked task

## Non-ASCII

日本語のテキストです。これは分割の境界がコードポイントを壊さないことを確認するためのものです。

Emoji in a heading and body: 🔒 🗝️ 📁

Mixed **bold**, _italic_, `inline code`, and a [link](https://example.invalid).
